findings.body: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
findings.failure_mode: Incorrect list reconciliation and React key warnings at runtime.
findings.impact: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
findings.root_cause: The replacement of GrafanaRuleLoader with GrafanaRuleListItem dropped the `key={key}` prop that existed on the removed element inside the `rules.map()` callback.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the already-destructured `key` prop to `<GrafanaRuleListItem key={key} ... />` as the previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} .../>` did.
findings.title: Missing React `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView list
findings.trigger: Rendering the filtered rule list when at least one result has origin 'grafana' (any filter search that returns Grafana-managed rules).
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line R157 shows `<GrafanaRuleListItem` without a `key` prop, while the removed L158 had `key={key}`. The `key` variable is destructured at L152 but not passed. This causes React key warnings and incorrect reconciliation.

pr.title: Alerting: Remove ruler from alert list view2

raw_findings.body: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Incorrect list reconciliation and React key warnings at runtime.
raw_findings.impact: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
raw_findings.root_cause: The replacement of GrafanaRuleLoader with GrafanaRuleListItem dropped the `key={key}` prop that existed on the removed element inside the `rules.map()` callback.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Pass the already-destructured `key` prop to `<GrafanaRuleListItem key={key} ... />` as the previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} .../>` did.
raw_findings.title: Missing React `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView list
raw_findings.trigger: Rendering the filtered rule list when at least one result has origin 'grafana' (any filter search that returns Grafana-managed rules).

raw_findings.body: The Delete menu item never renders because the menu body still requires `rulerRule` (`{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`), so users can no longer delete Grafana rules from the list view even though the new ability computation says they may.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silently missing UI action; the computed ability has no effect.
raw_findings.impact: The Delete menu item never renders because the menu body still requires `rulerRule` (`{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`), so users can no longer delete Grafana rules from the list view even though the new ability computation says they may.
raw_findings.root_cause: Abilities were extended to a promRule-only code path, but the menu item rendering conditions and `handleDelete` signature still depend on a `RulerRuleDTO` that is never supplied in the list view.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Make the delete menu item and `handleDelete` work from the Grafana Prometheus rule/identifier (e.g. gate on `canDelete && (rulerRule || prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(promRule))` and pass the rule identifier instead of `RulerRuleDTO`).
raw_findings.title: Delete action is unreachable for rules rendered from Prometheus data only
raw_findings.trigger: Open the alert rule list (GrafanaRuleListItem → RuleActionsButtons with only `promRule`) as a user with folder delete permission and click "More".

raw_findings.body: `MenuItemPauseRule` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, which is false without a ruler rule, so the pause/resume entry disappears from the list view despite `canPause` being true.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silently missing UI action; feature regression in the list view.
raw_findings.impact: `MenuItemPauseRule` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, which is false without a ruler rule, so the pause/resume entry disappears from the list view despite `canPause` being true.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new promRule-based ability is OR-ed into `canPause` while the render condition still requires a `RulerRuleDTO`.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Render the pause menu item from the Grafana Prometheus rule (pass uid/isPaused from `promRule`) or keep the ruler rule available for this action.
raw_findings.title: Pause action is unreachable for rules rendered from Prometheus data only
raw_findings.trigger: Open the alert rule list for a Grafana-managed alerting rule (only `promRule` is passed) as a user with edit permission and open the "More" menu.

raw_findings.body: The menu item renders and sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, so nothing happens — users see a dead menu entry.
raw_findings.impact: The menu item renders and sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, so nothing happens — users see a dead menu entry.
raw_findings.root_cause: Silence ability was enabled via the new promRule path while the drawer rendering condition still depends on a ruler rule that is undefined in the list view.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Render the silence drawer from the Grafana Prometheus rule uid (or a rule identifier) instead of requiring `RulerGrafanaRuleDTO`, so the action works when only `promRule` is available.
raw_findings.title: Silence menu item becomes a no-op without a ruler rule
raw_findings.trigger: In the rule list view (only `promRule` provided) with silence permissions, click "More" → "Silence notifications".

raw_findings.body: `Duplicate` resolves to `[true, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)]`, and because AlertRuleMenu ORs ruler and Grafana abilities, the Duplicate entry appears for cloud rules even when the ruler path says the action is unsupported (e.g. read-only Prometheus data source), leading the user into a clone flow that cannot succeed.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Actions are offered for rules the user/data source cannot support.
raw_findings.impact: `Duplicate` resolves to `[true, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)]`, and because AlertRuleMenu ORs ruler and Grafana abilities, the Duplicate entry appears for cloud rules even when the ruler path says the action is unsupported (e.g. read-only Prometheus data source), leading the user into a clone flow that cannot succeed.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new hook derives support flags without checking that a rule was actually supplied, so the skipToken/undefined case yields supported=true instead of not-supported.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Short-circuit `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` to return all `[false, false]` abilities when `rule` is undefined (or set `MaybeSupported = rule ? ... : NotSupported`).
raw_findings.title: Grafana Prom abilities return permissive defaults when the rule is skipped/undefined
raw_findings.trigger: Render `AlertRuleMenu` for a data-source (Mimir/Prometheus) rule: `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` is called with `skipToken`, so `rule` is `undefined`, `loading` is false and `MaybeSupported` becomes `AlwaysSupported`.

raw_findings.body: `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` is no longer evaluated (the delegate hardcodes `isFederated = false`), so Edit/Delete/Pause become supported for federated rules that were previously immutable, letting users start edits that the backend rejects.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Permission/ability regression exposing mutating actions on immutable rules.
raw_findings.impact: `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` is no longer evaluated (the delegate hardcodes `isFederated = false`), so Edit/Delete/Pause become supported for federated rules that were previously immutable, letting users start edits that the backend rejects.
raw_findings.root_cause: Delegating the CombinedRule-based hook to the ruler-rule hook discards the group object required for the federated-group check.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep the federated check in `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` (e.g. compute `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and pass it into `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, or override the returned abilities) until federated support is implemented in the new hook.
raw_findings.title: Federated rule-group immutability check dropped from useAllAlertRuleAbilities
raw_findings.trigger: View a Mimir federated rule group (group with `source_tenants`) in the rules table / rule viewer, which still uses `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule)`.

raw_findings.body: The previous implementation built the href with `{ returnTo }` from `createReturnTo()`; without it the detail page loses the return-to-previous context and the user is not sent back to the filtered list.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Navigation regression: return-to-previous no longer points at the rule list.
raw_findings.impact: The previous implementation built the href with `{ returnTo }` from `createReturnTo()`; without it the detail page loses the return-to-previous context and the user is not sent back to the filtered list.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new list item component was written without porting the `createReturnTo()` usage from the deleted GrafanaRuleLoader.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Restore `const returnTo = createReturnTo();` and build the href as `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })`.
raw_findings.title: Rule view link no longer carries returnTo parameter
raw_findings.trigger: Click a Grafana rule title from the rule list and then use the "Return to previous" control on the rule detail page.

raw_findings.body: The dangling `// duplicate` note carries no meaning for readers and suggests unfinished de-duplication work was shipped, confusing future maintainers.
raw_findings.evidence: const { isEditable, isRemovable, loading } = useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule); // duplicate
raw_findings.impact: The dangling `// duplicate` note carries no meaning for readers and suggests unfinished de-duplication work was shipped, confusing future maintainers.
raw_findings.root_cause: A work-in-progress scratch comment was left in the added code.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `// duplicate` trailing comment (or replace it with an explanatory TODO stating what should be de-duplicated).
raw_findings.title: Leftover '// duplicate' marker comment in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities
raw_findings.trigger: Reading or maintaining the new ability hook.

raw_findings.body: The suite passes while Delete (and Pause) are absent from the list-view menu, so the regression introduced by dropping the ruler rule is not detected by CI.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test blind spot: a user-facing capability loss is asserted as correct.
raw_findings.impact: The suite passes while Delete (and Pause) are absent from the list-view menu, so the regression introduced by dropping the ruler rule is not detected by CI.
raw_findings.root_cause: The rewritten test encodes the post-change behavior as expected rather than asserting the permission-driven actions the granted permissions imply.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Assert explicitly on `ui.menuItems.delete()` (and the pause item) for a user with delete/edit permissions instead of only counting menu items, so the missing actions fail the test.
raw_findings.title: New menu test locks in the missing Delete/Pause actions
raw_findings.trigger: Run GrafanaGroupLoader tests: the beforeEach grants `AlertingRuleDelete` (both globally and via folder access control) yet the test asserts exactly four menu items and never uses the declared `ui.menuItems.delete` selector.

raw_findings.body: A warning is emitted on every render of every affected row, flooding the analytics/logging backend for large rule lists.
raw_findings.evidence: logWarning('Unable to construct an editable rule identifier');
raw_findings.failure_mode: Repeated side effect per render causing log/analytics noise.
raw_findings.impact: A warning is emitted on every render of every affected row, flooding the analytics/logging backend for large rule lists.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new `getEditableIdentifier` helper performs a logging side effect and is called unconditionally during render.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Move the logging into a `useEffect` keyed on the rule identity, or de-duplicate/rate-limit the warning, instead of calling it inside the render body.

finding.verifier_reason: This is a test_gap category finding about test coverage. The test at R207 asserts 4 menu items which may be correct behavior for the promRule-only path. Without evidence that delete/pause should appear, this is speculative about test adequacy rather than a proven defect.

rejected_findings.reason: This is a test_gap category finding about test coverage. The test at R207 asserts 4 menu items which may be correct behavior for the promRule-only path. Without evidence that delete/pause should appear, this is speculative about test adequacy rather than a proven defect.

finding.body: A warning is emitted on every render of every affected row, flooding the analytics/logging backend for large rule lists.
finding.evidence: logWarning('Unable to construct an editable rule identifier');
finding.failure_mode: Repeated side effect per render causing log/analytics noise.
finding.impact: A warning is emitted on every render of every affected row, flooding the analytics/logging backend for large rule lists.
finding.root_cause: The new `getEditableIdentifier` helper performs a logging side effect and is called unconditionally during render.
finding.suggested_fix: Move the logging into a `useEffect` keyed on the rule identity, or de-duplicate/rate-limit the warning, instead of calling it inside the render body.
finding.title: logWarning invoked from the render path of RuleActionsButtons
finding.trigger: Render a rule row where neither a `RulerRuleDTO` nor a Grafana prom rule is available (e.g. a data-source rule whose ruler rule has not loaded); the list re-renders on each poll interval.
finding.verifier_reason: The logWarning at R146 is called only when neither rule nor promRule can produce an identifier - an error condition, not normal render path. The claim of 'every render of every affected row' is ungrounded; this is a fallback error case, not a performance issue.

rejected_findings.reason: The logWarning at R146 is called only when neither rule nor promRule can produce an identifier - an error condition, not normal render path. The claim of 'every render of every affected row' is ungrounded; this is a fallback error case, not a performance issue.

validated_findings.body: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Incorrect list reconciliation and React key warnings at runtime.
validated_findings.impact: React logs a "Each child in a list should have a unique key" warning and reconciles list items by index; when new pages of results are appended or the filter changes, item state/DOM can be reused for the wrong rule, causing flicker or stale rows.
validated_findings.root_cause: The replacement of GrafanaRuleLoader with GrafanaRuleListItem dropped the `key={key}` prop that existed on the removed element inside the `rules.map()` callback.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Pass the already-destructured `key` prop to `<GrafanaRuleListItem key={key} ... />` as the previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} .../>` did.
validated_findings.title: Missing React `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView list
validated_findings.trigger: Rendering the filtered rule list when at least one result has origin 'grafana' (any filter search that returns Grafana-managed rules).
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch line R157 shows `<GrafanaRuleListItem` without a `key` prop, while the removed L158 had `key={key}`. The `key` variable is destructured at L152 but not passed. This causes React key warnings and incorrect reconciliation.

validated_findings.body: The Delete menu item never renders because the menu body still requires `rulerRule` (`{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`), so users can no longer delete Grafana rules from the list view even though the new ability computation says they may.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Silently missing UI action; the computed ability has no effect.
validated_findings.impact: The Delete menu item never renders because the menu body still requires `rulerRule` (`{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`), so users can no longer delete Grafana rules from the list view even though the new ability computation says they may.
validated_findings.root_cause: Abilities were extended to a promRule-only code path, but the menu item rendering conditions and `handleDelete` signature still depend on a `RulerRuleDTO` that is never supplied in the list view.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Make the delete menu item and `handleDelete` work from the Grafana Prometheus rule/identifier (e.g. gate on `canDelete && (rulerRule || prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(promRule))` and pass the rule identifier instead of `RulerRuleDTO`).
validated_findings.title: Delete action is unreachable for rules rendered from Prometheus data only
validated_findings.trigger: Open the alert rule list (GrafanaRuleListItem → RuleActionsButtons with only `promRule`) as a user with folder delete permission and click "More".
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch adds `canDelete` computation at R87 using OR of ruler and grafana abilities, but AlertRuleMenu.tsx:165 shows delete menu item still requires `{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`. When only promRule is passed (no rulerRule), the menu item won't render despite canDelete being true.

validated_findings.body: `MenuItemPauseRule` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, which is false without a ruler rule, so the pause/resume entry disappears from the list view despite `canPause` being true.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Silently missing UI action; feature regression in the list view.
validated_findings.impact: `MenuItemPauseRule` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, which is false without a ruler rule, so the pause/resume entry disappears from the list view despite `canPause` being true.
validated_findings.root_cause: The new promRule-based ability is OR-ed into `canPause` while the render condition still requires a `RulerRuleDTO`.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Render the pause menu item from the Grafana Prometheus rule (pass uid/isPaused from `promRule`) or keep the ruler rule available for this action.
validated_findings.title: Pause action is unreachable for rules rendered from Prometheus data only
validated_findings.trigger: Open the alert rule list for a Grafana-managed alerting rule (only `promRule` is passed) as a user with edit permission and open the "More" menu.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Same root cause as candidate 1: canPause at R83 is computed but MenuItemPauseRule at line 123 requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` which fails without rulerRule. Same fix location and pattern.

validated_findings.body: The menu item renders and sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, so nothing happens — users see a dead menu entry.
validated_findings.impact: The menu item renders and sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, so nothing happens — users see a dead menu entry.
validated_findings.root_cause: Silence ability was enabled via the new promRule path while the drawer rendering condition still depends on a ruler rule that is undefined in the list view.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Render the silence drawer from the Grafana Prometheus rule uid (or a rule identifier) instead of requiring `RulerGrafanaRuleDTO`, so the action works when only `promRule` is available.
validated_findings.title: Silence menu item becomes a no-op without a ruler rule
validated_findings.trigger: In the rule list view (only `promRule` provided) with silence permissions, click "More" → "Silence notifications".
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Same pattern as candidates 1-2: canSilence at R96 is computed but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer rendering at RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:104 requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. Same causal defect family.

validated_findings.body: `Duplicate` resolves to `[true, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)]`, and because AlertRuleMenu ORs ruler and Grafana abilities, the Duplicate entry appears for cloud rules even when the ruler path says the action is unsupported (e.g. read-only Prometheus data source), leading the user into a clone flow that cannot succeed.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Actions are offered for rules the user/data source cannot support.
validated_findings.impact: `Duplicate` resolves to `[true, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)]`, and because AlertRuleMenu ORs ruler and Grafana abilities, the Duplicate entry appears for cloud rules even when the ruler path says the action is unsupported (e.g. read-only Prometheus data source), leading the user into a clone flow that cannot succeed.
validated_findings.root_cause: The new hook derives support flags without checking that a rule was actually supplied, so the skipToken/undefined case yields supported=true instead of not-supported.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Short-circuit `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` to return all `[false, false]` abilities when `rule` is undefined (or set `MaybeSupported = rule ? ... : NotSupported`).
validated_findings.title: Grafana Prom abilities return permissive defaults when the rule is skipped/undefined
validated_findings.trigger: Render `AlertRuleMenu` for a data-source (Mimir/Prometheus) rule: `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` is called with `skipToken`, so `rule` is `undefined`, `loading` is false and `MaybeSupported` becomes `AlwaysSupported`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The claim that skipToken causes AlwaysSupported is incorrect. Line R309 shows `MaybeSupported = loading ? NotSupported : AlwaysSupported` but this is inside useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities which receives GrafanaPromRuleDTO, not skipToken. The skipToken check happens at the call site (R73) before invoking the hook.

validated_findings.body: `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` is no longer evaluated (the delegate hardcodes `isFederated = false`), so Edit/Delete/Pause become supported for federated rules that were previously immutable, letting users start edits that the backend rejects.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Permission/ability regression exposing mutating actions on immutable rules.
validated_findings.impact: `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` is no longer evaluated (the delegate hardcodes `isFederated = false`), so Edit/Delete/Pause become supported for federated rules that were previously immutable, letting users start edits that the backend rejects.
validated_findings.root_cause: Delegating the CombinedRule-based hook to the ruler-rule hook discards the group object required for the federated-group check.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Keep the federated check in `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` (e.g. compute `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and pass it into `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, or override the returned abilities) until federated support is implemented in the new hook.
validated_findings.title: Federated rule-group immutability check dropped from useAllAlertRuleAbilities
validated_findings.trigger: View a Mimir federated rule group (group with `source_tenants`) in the rules table / rule viewer, which still uses `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule)`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The patch at R228 shows useAllAlertRuleAbilities delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, but useAllRulerRuleAbilities at L245 still has `const isFederated = false` with a TODO comment. The federated check was already hardcoded false before this change; no regression introduced.

validated_findings.body: The previous implementation built the href with `{ returnTo }` from `createReturnTo()`; without it the detail page loses the return-to-previous context and the user is not sent back to the filtered list.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Navigation regression: return-to-previous no longer points at the rule list.
validated_findings.impact: The previous implementation built the href with `{ returnTo }` from `createReturnTo()`; without it the detail page loses the return-to-previous context and the user is not sent back to the filtered list.
validated_findings.root_cause: The new list item component was written without porting the `createReturnTo()` usage from the deleted GrafanaRuleLoader.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Restore `const returnTo = createReturnTo();` and build the href as `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })`.
validated_findings.title: Rule view link no longer carries returnTo parameter
validated_findings.trigger: Click a Grafana rule title from the rule list and then use the "Return to previous" control on the rule detail page.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch R40 shows `href: createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` without returnTo parameter. The deleted GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx used `createReturnTo()` for this purpose. This is a navigation UX regression.

validated_findings.body: The dangling `// duplicate` note carries no meaning for readers and suggests unfinished de-duplication work was shipped, confusing future maintainers.
validated_findings.evidence: const { isEditable, isRemovable, loading } = useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule); // duplicate
validated_findings.impact: The dangling `// duplicate` note carries no meaning for readers and suggests unfinished de-duplication work was shipped, confusing future maintainers.
validated_findings.root_cause: A work-in-progress scratch comment was left in the added code.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `// duplicate` trailing comment (or replace it with an explanatory TODO stating what should be de-duplicated).
validated_findings.title: Leftover '// duplicate' marker comment in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities
validated_findings.trigger: Reading or maintaining the new ability hook.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a style/comment issue about `// duplicate` marker at R289. Style findings are explicitly excluded per instructions.

validated_findings.body: The suite passes while Delete (and Pause) are absent from the list-view menu, so the regression introduced by dropping the ruler rule is not detected by CI.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Test blind spot: a user-facing capability loss is asserted as correct.
validated_findings.impact: The suite passes while Delete (and Pause) are absent from the list-view menu, so the regression introduced by dropping the ruler rule is not detected by CI.
validated_findings.root_cause: The rewritten test encodes the post-change behavior as expected rather than asserting the permission-driven actions the granted permissions imply.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Assert explicitly on `ui.menuItems.delete()` (and the pause item) for a user with delete/edit permissions instead of only counting menu items, so the missing actions fail the test.
